gear.name: Foam earplugs
gear.text: Absorbs one noise complication. The crew all look a bit sleepy.
gear.absorbed: The earplugs go in and the noise does not bother anyone.

gear.name: Cat treats
gear.text: Absorbs one cat complication. Smells of fish.
gear.absorbed: A treat rolls down the corridor and the cat follows it, delighted.

gear.name: Lucky coin
gear.text: Once per heist, one failed or messy action gets another try.
